text:
sam: Heads-up — pushed a Terraform + kustomize overlay that updates namespace RBAC and tries to add the IRSA annotation on the ServiceAccount. Hitting a merge conflict with the helm values for the same chart. Can someone sanity-check before I apply?

jordan: Which chart is this? Helm or chartlib? quick snippet + where you put the patch would help.

sam: It's the billing-worker chart (helm release). I initially tried adding via kustomize overlay in overlays/prod/patch-sa.yaml:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: billing-worker
  namespace: billing-prod
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-prod-billing-sa
```
But the helm chart has `createServiceAccount: true` and also exposes `serviceAccount.annotations` in values. Helm is winning during deploy and my kustomize patch gets clobbered.

lee: If helm manages the SA, it will overwrite kustomize. Two approaches: (A) set helm `createServiceAccount: false` and let kustomize create/apply the SA (B) keep helm creating SA and put `serviceAccount.annotations` in your helm values. I'd prefer B for a single source of truth.

maria: Agree with @lee. Also watch out for ordering: if kustomize runs as a post-renderer or after helm then patches could stick, but that's an awkward flow. Better to standardize on helm values for charts that manage SA.

sam: Good call. Question: I added the IAM role in terraform (aws_iam_role + aws_iam_role_policy). terraform plan looked fine locally but want to ensure the annotation matches the role ARN and OIDC mapping. infra-bot — any plan output?

terraform-bot: terraform plan: will create resource aws_iam_role.redwood_billing_prod (new) and aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.* (new). No other changes.

lee: Make sure the role's trust policy uses the cluster OIDC provider and the condition includes `StringEquals: {"sts:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com", "kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace": "billing-prod", "kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/service-account-name": "billing-worker"}` (or equivalent). If mismatch, annotation won't let pods assume role.

sam: Ok I'll: 1) move the annotation into helm values under `serviceAccount.annotations`, 2) remove the kustomize SA patch from overlays/prod, 3) re-run terraform plan then apply. Plan to apply around 16:00 PST. Any objections? :point_right:

jordan: lgtm :thumbsup:

maria: sgtm — just make sure you run the staging helm render and sanity-check the rendered SA manifest before apply.

sam: Will do, I'll post the rendered manifest here once done and tag y'all. Thanks!
